data.title: My Pattern Maker
data.description: Build your very own fun patterns all by yourself!

challenges.instruction: Make your own A B pattern (two things taking turns). Use any tokens, and repeat it at least two times.
challenges.hint: Make your first part, then make the same part again.
challenges.narration: Make a pattern of your own.

challenges.instruction: Make your own A B B pattern (one thing, then two the same). Use any tokens, and repeat it at least two times.
challenges.hint: Make your first part, then make the same part again.
challenges.narration: Make a pattern of your own.

challenges.instruction: Make your own A A B pattern (two the same, then one different). Use any tokens, and repeat it at least two times.
challenges.hint: Make your first part, then make the same part again.
challenges.narration: Make a pattern of your own.

challenges.instruction: Make your own A B C pattern (three different things in a row). Use any tokens, and repeat it at least two times.
challenges.hint: Make your first part, then make the same part again.
challenges.narration: Make a pattern of your own.

challenges.instruction: Make your own A A B B pattern (two the same, then two of another). Use any tokens, and repeat it at least two times.
challenges.hint: Make your first part, then make the same part again.
challenges.narration: Make a pattern of your own.
